articles.title: Signal Vulnerability Could Keep Microphone Active Even After Users Hang Up
articles.summary:
A critical vulnerability in Signal’s RingRTC calling library could let a malicious call participant keep receiving audio after another user tries to hang up. This vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-113380, affects versions of RingRTC before 2.72.0 and carries a CVSS v4.0 score of 9.3. articles.title: Node.js Patches 10 Security Vulnerabilities, Including High-Severity RCE Flaw
articles.summary:

articles.title: LiteLLM Supply Chain Compromise Exposes AI Developer Credentials to Malware Attacks
articles.summary:
LiteLLM version 1.107.0 was compromised in a supply chain attack that distributed credential-stealing malware through PyPI wheels and container images.
